## Approach

Walk through what you did and, more importantly, why. Where you had a choice
between two methods, say which you picked and what it cost you.

```{sql}
#| eval: false
-- Show real SQL where SQL is the honest tool for the step.
select hts_code,
       count(*) as entries,
       sum(duty_paid) as duty
from entries
group by hts_code
order by duty desc;
```
